# FinanzBuddy 0.3.2

Bugfix release on branch `bugfix-0.3.2`: follow-up bank import, buy-list group split assignment, and amount-column band styling in production builds.

## Bank import (Settings)

- **Follow-up import after setup:** append-only mode when setup is already completed — no balance prompt, no opening-balance back-calculation, no primary-income wizard.
- Existing transactions matched by bank reference are **skipped without update**; only **new** transactions are inserted.

## Transactions — buy-list groups

- Assigning a transaction to a **buy-list group** opens a split dialog: map the transaction amount to individual group items.
- Not all sub-items are required; the split sum must equal the transaction amount.
- Multiple transactions can cover one group; each sub-item can be linked to at most one transaction.
- New DB table `ledger_buy_group_splits`; full-group apply from the buy list still auto-splits when the amount matches the group total.

## Tables — amount column bands

- Restored the original **continuous column overlay** (one band behind amount cells, not per-cell boxes).
- Improved measurement timing for production builds (layout/font readiness) so bands render reliably in release.
